title: Istio全局限流配置：Envoy过滤器、gRPC服务与路由描述符
body:
## 操作任务
在固定mesh-training素材上提交limits.yaml：为istio=ingressgateway的GATEWAY插入Envoy HTTP全局限流过滤器，使用ratelimit.mesh-training.svc.cluster.local:8081的gRPC服务、domain training、超时0.25秒，服务失败时拒绝。对*:8080中名为api的路由合并generic_key=approved描述符；提供匹配的参考限流服务ConfigMap，规则为每分钟60次。保留固定素材，不使用本地令牌桶替代全局服务。

## 产物
limits.yaml

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py，调用真实istioctl离线分析，并精确核对filter、路由descriptor与参考服务规则。

## 能力边界
官方istioctl1.31.3在隔离user/net namespace本地分析Gateway、路由和EnvoyFilter，独立检查外部gRPC限流服务集群、domain、失败关闭、路由descriptor和服务端规则的静态一致性。没有运行网关、Envoy、gRPC限流服务或Redis，不声称已真实限流、跨实例配额或生产可用；配置需按目标Istio/Envoy版本及实际路由名复核。无镜像构建、拉取或默认身份变更。
answer: 配置Envoy gRPC全局限流过滤器、路由描述符及匹配的服务端domain/规则；运行时部署和真实请求验证另行完成。
explanation: Envoy负责触发限流调用，外部限流服务根据匹配domain与descriptor裁决；静态资源存在不等于实际生效。
rubric: 官方本地分析通过；过滤器、路由描述符、服务端规则及失败策略与批准范围一致。
review_note: 真实Istio全局限流实操缺口绑定冻结空名额；原生及页面证据另存，不计旧题改编与原故障。

exercise.environment: 既有私有WSL普通student，真实istioctl隔离本地分析
exercise.operation: 提交全局限流过滤器、路由描述符和服务端规则。
exercise.validation_scope: 官方istioctl1.31.3在隔离user/net namespace本地分析Gateway、路由和EnvoyFilter，独立检查外部gRPC限流服务集群、domain、失败关闭、路由descriptor和服务端规则的静态一致性。没有运行网关、Envoy、gRPC限流服务或Redis，不声称已真实限流、跨实例配额或生产可用；配置需按目标Istio/Envoy版本及实际路由名复核。无镜像构建、拉取或默认身份变更。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile,yaml
assert os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
base=pathlib.Path('base.yaml');candidate=pathlib.Path('limits.yaml');assert hashlib.sha256(base.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='b329acf95a9a9955edce38e693058b4346a83eef79f20dfc729704deb92dae2c'
raw=candidate.read_text(encoding='utf8')
if raw.strip()=='# IMPLEMENT_GLOBAL_LIMIT':raise NotImplementedError('complete the approved global limit configuration')
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:actual_istioctl_global_rate_limit_configuration',flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-istio-limit-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);config=root/'kubeconfig.json';config.write_text(json.dumps({'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Config','clusters':[],'contexts':[],'users':[],'current-context':''}))
 env={**os.environ,'KUBECONFIG':str(config),'ISTIO_CONFIG_DIR':str(root/'config'),'GOMAXPROCS':'2','GOMEMLIMIT':'384MiB'}
 command=['unshare','-Urn','--','istioctl','analyze','--use-kube=false','--kubeconfig',str(config),'--namespace','mesh-training','--failure-threshold','Error',str(base.resolve()),str(candidate.resolve())]
 result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,env=env,timeout=20);assert result.returncode==0,result.stdout+result.stderr
docs=list(yaml.safe_load_all(raw));assert len(docs)==2 and {d['kind'] for d in docs}=={'EnvoyFilter','ConfigMap'}
ef=next(d for d in docs if d['kind']=='EnvoyFilter');cm=next(d for d in docs if d['kind']=='ConfigMap')
expected=json.loads('[{"apiVersion": "networking.istio.io/v1alpha3", "kind": "EnvoyFilter", "metadata": {"name": "global-limit", "namespace": "mesh-training"}, "spec": {"workloadSelector": {"labels": {"istio": "ingressgateway"}}, "configPatches": [{"applyTo": "HTTP_FILTER", "match": {"context": "GATEWAY", "listener": {"filterChain": {"filter": {"name": "envoy.filters.network.http_connection_manager", "subFilter": {"name": "envoy.filters.http.router"}}}}}, "patch": {"operation": "INSERT_BEFORE", "value": {"name": "envoy.filters.http.ratelimit", "typed_config": {"@type": "type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.ratelimit.v3.RateLimit", "domain": "training", "failure_mode_deny": true, "timeout": "0.25s", "rate_limit_service": {"grpc_service": {"envoy_grpc": {"cluster_name": "outbound|8081||ratelimit.mesh-training.svc.cluster.local"}}, "transport_api_version": "V3"}}}}}, {"applyTo": "HTTP_ROUTE", "match": {"context": "GATEWAY", "routeConfiguration": {"vhost": {"name": "*:8080", "route": {"name": "api"}}}}, "patch": {"operation": "MERGE", "value": {"route": {"rate_limits": [{"actions": [{"generic_key": {"descriptor_value": "approved"}}]}]}}}}]}}, {"apiVersion": "v1", "kind": "ConfigMap", "metadata": {"name": "rate-limit-rules", "namespace": "mesh-training"}, "data": {"config.yaml": "domain: training\\ndescriptors:\\n- key: generic_key\\n  value: approved\\n  rate_limit:\\n    unit: minute\\n    requests_per_unit: 60\\n"}}]');assert ef==expected[0] and cm['apiVersion']=='v1' and cm['metadata']==expected[1]['metadata'] and set(cm['data'])=={'config.yaml'}
rules=yaml.safe_load(cm['data']['config.yaml']);assert rules=={'domain':'training','descriptors':[{'key':'generic_key','value':'approved','rate_limit':{'unit':'minute','requests_per_unit':60}}]}
print('NATIVE_ISTIOCTL_GLOBAL_GRPC_FILTER_ROUTE_DESCRIPTOR_AND_SERVICE_RULES_STATIC_ONLY',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
